answer_1.quote: In this paper, we are interested in evaluating the visual capacities of pre-trained language models; in our case, BERT. To do so, we choose the Visual Question Generation (VQG) task ... We introduce BERT-gen, a text generator based on BERT, that can be applied both in mono and multi-modal settings.

answer_2.quote: We report the following metrics for all experiments, consistently with previous works: BLEU ... ROUGE ... METEOR ... CIDEr ...

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation To get more in-depth understanding of our models, we report human assessment results ... We asked 3 human annotators to assess the quality of each question using a Likert scale ranging from 1 to 5, for the following criteria: readability, caption relevance, and image relevance.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated question on a 1–5 Likert scale for readability, caption relevance, and image relevance.
